div.head: List of Papers
div.p: [The arrangement of this list is by chapters, the papers therein appearing chronologically under date of writing. Unless otherwise specified, the correspondence is from or to officials in the Department of State.]
CHAPTER I. LOANS TO THE PROVISIONAL GOVERNMENT—SOVIET FINANCIAL DECREES
